laws.rule: National park entry (general rate, which applies to foreign visitors), daily pass from 1 June 2026: Iguazú ARS 60,000. Children 0 to 6 free. Flexipass 3- and 7-day passes are also sold. No RBA rate for ARS.
laws.heading: Pase diario

laws.rule: Iguazú entry includes the Sendero Verde, the ecological train and the Upper, Lower and Garganta del Diablo circuits; pay in cash or by Visa or Mastercard.
